body:
Blocked by the mandatory Superpowers preflight; no implementation work was started.

Attempted steps:
1. Inspected the session-provided installed skills/plugins. No `superpowers:*` skill or `superpowers@openai-curated-remote` plugin capability is available.
2. Called the environment plugin-install workflow with the exact ID `superpowers@openai-curated-remote`.
3. The install request failed with the exact error: `plugin_id must match one of the entries in the <recommended_plugins> list`.
4. Because installation failed, `superpowers:using-superpowers` could not be invoked. The other mandated Superpowers workflows likewise cannot be invoked.

Per the issue hard preflight and stop conditions, I did not inspect implementation details or modify repository files. The temporary local files used to read issue/PR metadata were removed, and the worktree remains clean.

Human action needed: make the official `superpowers@openai-curated-remote` plugin available in this environment, then rerun the solver.

The hive-mind capability-provisioning fix is now available for review in https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2075.

It detects explicit plugin/Agent Skill requirements before the solver session, installs the provider into persistent per-repository Codex state, and propagates that state to direct and Docker runs. Once merged, rerun the original task through hive-mind; it should provision `superpowers@openai-curated` before Codex starts.

For a manual workaround with the current Codex CLI, run `codex plugin add superpowers@openai-curated` in the operator environment before retrying.
